# Lisbon 4-Day Budget Trip Plan

A relaxed Lisbon plan for **2 adults** from **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13**, built around museums, viewpoints, and local food. I’ve kept it to **no more than 2 major activities per day** and aimed to stay comfortably within your **€1,200 total budget excluding flights**.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Cost Plan

Day 1: Baixa, Alfama, and a sunset viewpoint
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and do a gentle walk through **Baixa** and **Rossio**.
- Afternoon: Visit **Lisbon Cathedral** and wander the old streets of **Alfama**.
- Food: Simple lunch of bifana/sandwiches; dinner in Alfama with grilled fish or petiscos.
- Cost estimate: **Food €70-90**, **Transit €10-15**, **Total €80-105**
- Good pace note: Keep the day light and save energy for the viewpoint at sunset.

Day 2: Belém museums and riverside food
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit **Jerónimos Monastery** or the **National Coach Museum**.
- Afternoon: Walk the riverside in **Belém** and stop at **Belém Tower** or **MAAT** if you want one more cultural stop.
- Food: Pastéis de Belém, plus a casual seafood or codfish lunch.
- Cost estimate: **Food €80-100**, **Transit €12-18**, **Total €92-118**
- Good pace note: This is your best museum-focused day without feeling rushed.

Day 3: Chiado, Bairro Alto, and city views
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Morning: Explore **Chiado** and choose one museum, such as the **National Museum of Contemporary Art** or **Carmo Archaeological Museum**.
- Afternoon: Relax in **Bairro Alto** and head to a nearby viewpoint like **Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara**.
- Food: Lunch at a tascas-style spot; dinner with traditional Portuguese dishes and wine.
- Cost estimate: **Food €75-95**, **Transit €10-15**, **Total €85-110**
- Good pace note: Great day for a slower city-center rhythm with one cultural stop and one scenic stop.

Day 4: Tram neighborhoods and a final food stop
- Morning: Ride through **Graça** or **Estrela** for neighborhood views and a café break.
- Afternoon: Choose one last highlight: **National Tile Museum** or a long lunch with a neighborhood stroll.
- Food: Brunch or late breakfast, then a final seafood or pastry stop before departure.
- Cost estimate: **Food €65-90**, **Transit €10-15**, **Total €75-105**
- Good pace note: Keep this flexible for check-out and departure timing.

## Budget Fit and Best Neighborhoods to Stay

| Neighborhood | Why it works | Budget level | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Baixa | Central, easy transit, walkable | Mid-range | First-time visitors who want convenience |
| Arroios | Often better value, good metro access | Budget-friendly | Saving money without being too far out |
| Anjos | Affordable food and lodging options | Budget-friendly | Longer stays and practical transit access |
| Graça | Scenic, local feel, quieter evenings | Mid-range | Views and a more residential pace |
| Campo de Ourique | Relaxed, local, good cafés | Mid-range | A calmer stay with neighborhood character |

## Cost Outlook for the Whole Trip

- **Food total:** about **€290-375** for 2 adults
- **Transit total:** about **€42-63** for 2 adults
- **Activities and entry tickets:** about **€120-220** depending on how many museums you choose
- **Estimated total on the ground:** about **€452-658**
- This leaves a comfortable buffer inside your **€1,200** budget for nicer meals, extra tickets, taxis, or shopping.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Museum tickets](https://www.visitlisboa.com/en)

- Lisbon tourism overview: https://www.visitlisboa.com/en
- Lisbon Metro: https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/
- Jerónimos Monastery visitor info: https://www.museusemonumentos.pt/en
- National Coach Museum: https://museudoscoches.gov.pt/en/
